name: MS-03
label: Safe R

key_factors: Strong Republican district with a +14 R partisan lean
Incumbent Michael Guest running with a large cash advantage
Polymarket prices Guest at 98% to win
Democratic challenger is minimally funded with no polling presence
model.rationale: The fundamentals point firmly to Guest: a heavily Republican district, incumbency, and a roughly five-to-one fundraising edge, with markets pricing the race at 98% Republican. No polls or expert ratings suggest any reason to move materially from that picture.
model.watch: A sudden influx of outside spending against Guest or a major scandal would be the only plausible path to making this competitive.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Michael Guest, the Republican incumbent, is seeking another term in a Mississippi district that leans about fourteen points Republican. He has raised more than $820,000 and holds a large cash advantage over Democratic challenger Michael Chiaradio, who has raised about $155,000 and has little on hand. A Libertarian candidate is also on the ballot.

No public polls or expert ratings cover the race, but prediction markets give Guest roughly a 98 percent chance of winning. With the district's strong partisan lean, the incumbent's financial edge, and no visible challenger activity, the race is rated Safe Republican.
